title: Breadcrumbs
summary: Correlate fragments across four documents to identify a researcher and their alias.
briefing:
NebulaCorp's threat intelligence team intercepted four documents related to a vulnerability disclosure that may affect corporate infrastructure. The documents come from different sources and each contains partial information about the researcher involved.

Your task: correlate the information across all four documents to identify the researcher's real name and their forum handle.

Submit your finding as RANGE{osint_<first_initial>_<last_name_lowercase>_<forum_handle>}

For example, if the researcher were Alex Chen with handle "rev_ninja", the flag would be RANGE{osint_a_chen_rev_ninja}.
objectives: Read all four documents and note identifying details
Cross-reference names, handles, email addresses and organizations
Identify the researcher and their forum handle

hints.title: Start with the email
hints.text: The email headers contain both a real name (From:) and a forum handle (Message-ID). Cross-reference these with the other documents.

hints.title: Name format
hints.text: The researcher's first name starts with J. Their last name is in the email From header. The forum handle appears in the forum post signature.

artifacts.description: Intercepted email headers and partial body.
WHOIS record for a research domain.
